code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The three-color seed is a horizontal sequence on an edge; each matching
    # remote marker extends its color along the seed column and marker row.
    seedrow=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v!=0 for v in row)>=3)
    cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[seedrow]) if v]
    for c in cols:
        color=grid[seedrow][c]
        for r in range(h):
            if r!=seedrow and grid[r][c]==color:
                for rr in range(min(seedrow,r),max(seedrow,r)+1): out[rr][c]=color
                for cc in range(min(c, next((x for x in range(w) if grid[r][x]==color and x!=c),c)), max(c,next((x for x in range(w) if grid[r][x]==color and x!=c),c))+1): out[r][cc]=color
        # Remote marker may be horizontal from edge, derive its location not seed column.
        for r in range(h):
            for cc in range(w):
                if grid[r][cc]==color and r!=seedrow and cc not in cols:
                    for rr in range(min(seedrow,r),max(seedrow,r)+1): out[rr][c]=color
                    for x in range(min(c,cc),max(c,cc)+1): out[r][x]=color
    return out
'''

    return out
